title: STARBATTLE
author: vrdrift
selftext:
Hi,

I have been working on this project and off for about 7 weeks. While working on about 5 other AI projects in parallel including my free Souls-like (https://wbk.itch.io/chapel-knights) I posted about the other day. Safe to say AI has made me quite productive.

It started as a test to use up tokens before a GPT reset. It's about 95% made with GPT, and the rest was mostly a very brief test with Grok, and then all the art was retouched with Fable/Opus5.

Similar to my Souls-like:

\- All game specific code/art/animation/sfx/music is created by agents

\- No specialised AI models for art/sfx were used apart from this videos music is Suno

\- Minimal custom C++ base game framework, box3d, sdl3, miniaudio

Still very much work in progress, lots to do on art etc but it has continued to have fun gameplay since its inception.

comments.author: IcyBother8850
comments.body: How are you modeling the ships and the robots?

replies.author: vrdrift
replies.body: They are all procedurally generated in C++ code with fairly extensive specific prompting in some cases (this wasn't as automated as my recent Souls-like game). They were originally made by GPT but then I had Opus 5 redo a lot of them but they still need a lot more work.

replies.author: IcyBother8850
replies.body: Niice, I started using Meshy + Manually adding rigging for item slots in blender, was wondering if there was anything better but doesnt seem like it.

replies.author: vrdrift
replies.body: Mesh/Tripo etc will definitely get you higher quality models much faster yes.
